run_intuitive_physics_evaluation: run the main evaluation pipeline for intuitive physics datasets using a pretrained JEPA or MAE model
extract_reconstruction_losses: extract per-video L1 reconstruction losses from a pretrained encoder-predictor model across multiple context lengths
compute_discrimination_metrics: compute pairwise accuracy, AUPRC, and AUROC metrics from real vs fake video reconstruction losses
init_video_model: initialize a pretrained video vision transformer encoder with optional target encoder and predictor for evaluation
load_pretrained_checkpoint: load pretrained encoder, target encoder, and predictor weights from a checkpoint file with shape mismatch handling
